note: Manual classification of the 39 surviving mutants of the final v2 (fork 5b62818; backend identical at 6a26954) under the 45-check probe and the repository tests. Mutant = file:line:id as printed by e5_survivor_diffs.py. 'harmless' = cannot change any authorization decision, effect or decision record on a state the API can reach. The pip.py, pip_invalidation.py and delegations.py survivors are the same mutants as in phase 4 (those files did not change after 49d99a9). 'e1c' = result of e1c_on_survivors.py (results/phase5/e1c_on_e5v4_survivors.json).

cache_bypass.label: cache never read/written (falls back to DB)
cache_bypass.why: mutant disables reading or writing the grant cache (or makes the Lua call fail, caught); every decision then reads PostgreSQL; performance only

equivalent.label: equivalent on the attribute domain
equivalent.why: documents.py:446: minimum clearance rank is 1 (normal), so comparing the sensitivity rank with 0, 1 or -1 cannot change the barrier (E1c agrees on all worlds); pip.py:187 >= vs > on float time; pip.py:205 ttl 0 rejected by Redis and caught as before; pip.py:202 tz handling identical in a UTC deployment

metadata.label: decision metadata (latency, flags)
metadata.why: elapsed_ms value and the pep_enforced context flag, which no rule reads

timing.label: timing constants (+-0.1 %, 1 ms)
timing.why: TTL scale x1.001/x0.999 and 1 ms cut-off; the generation bump makes entries unreachable after a commit and the expiry check at read time bounds validity

notification.label: revocation notice text/recipient
notification.why: changes the notification sent after a delegation revocation; not an authorization effect

masked.label: masked by redundant defence
masked.why: pip.py:187-188 expiry check at read: the entry TTL is already capped at the validity end (truncated down), so an expired entry is never present

fault_path.label: Redis-error / malformed-entry path
fault_path.why: return True instead of None on a Redis error or malformed entry; not exercised; the PDP then evaluates `action in True`, raises, and the request fails closed (500)

over_invalidation.label: over-invalidation on bulk writes
over_invalidation.why: or instead of and: every bulk UPDATE/DELETE bumps the global generation; more cache misses only

unreachable_state.label: published document without any linked object
unreachable_state.why: documents.py:434 `return False` -> `return True` when no object is linked to a published document; publishing always links an object and no route hard-deletes objects (DELETE /resources sets is_active = False), so the state is not reachable through the API; E1c, which enumerates it, kills both

risk_boundary.label: document risk check at rho = theta
risk_boundary.why: documents.py:424 `>=` -> `>`: a request whose score equals theta exactly is no longer denied on the document route; for published documents the PDP's own P_ctx (>=) still denies, for unpublished ones the workflow rules can then allow (R6); the probe's risk fixtures reach theta (S24/S25 sit exactly at it) only at the gate and on published documents, where P_ctx also denies; E1c, whose risk worlds sit exactly at theta, kills it

owner_exemption_flip.label: owner exemption from the barrier flipped to other departments
owner_exemption_flip.why: documents.py:442 `==` -> `!=` on the department in the owner exemption: an owner in her department whose clearance is below the document's sensitivity can no longer read her own unpublished document (liveness only); an owner in another department is exempted but no later rule lets her read an unpublished document, so nothing is granted; no probe check has an owner with clearance below her own draft; E1c kills it

internal_address.label: collaboration-server address used for internal calls
internal_address.why: main.py:194 `or` -> `and`: internal (collaboration-server) calls get the server's address instead of 'unknown', so the address-change term of rho can fire for a collaborator whose last known address differs, and her session is refused (deny only, liveness); with no client the middleware raises and the request fails closed (500), which uvicorn does not produce; no probe check opens a collaboration session from such a subject
